title: Reverse Nodes in k-Group
desc:
給定一個鏈表，每 k 個節點一組進行翻轉，返回翻轉後的鏈表。

限制條件：

  • k 是一個正整數，它的值小於或等於鏈表的長度
  • 如果節點總數不是 k 的整數倍，那麼請將最後剩餘的節點保持原有順序
  • 你不能只是單純的改變節點內部的值，而是需要實際進行節點交換

solutions.python:
# 方法一：遞迴解法
class Solution:
    def reverseKGroup(self, head: Optional[ListNode], k: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        # 1. 檢查是否有 k 個節點
        curr = head
        count = 0
        while curr and count < k:
            curr = curr.next
            count += 1
        
        # 不足 k 個，直接返回
        if count < k:
            return head
        
        # 2. 翻轉前 k 個節點
        prev = None
        curr = head
        next_node = None
        
        for i in range(k):
            next_node = curr.next
            curr.next = prev
            prev = curr
            curr = next_node
        
        # 3. 遞迴處理剩餘部分
        # prev 現在是翻轉後的頭節點
        # head 現在是翻轉後的尾節點
        # curr 是下一組的開始
        head.next = self.reverseKGroup(curr, k)
        
        # 4. 返回新頭節點
        return prev


# 方法二：迭代解法
class Solution:
    def reverseKGroup(self, head: Optional[ListNode], k: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        # 輔助函數：翻轉鏈表的一段 [start, end]
        def reverseSegment(start, end):
            prev = None
            curr = start
            while prev != end:
                next_node = curr.next
                curr.next = prev
                prev = curr
                curr = next_node
            return end, start  # 返回新頭和新尾
        
        dummy = ListNode(0)
        dummy.next = head
        prevGroup = dummy
        
        while True:
            # 找到當前組的第 k 個節點
            groupEnd = prevGroup
            for i in range(k):
                groupEnd = groupEnd.next
                if not groupEnd:
                    return dummy.next  # 不足 k 個
            
            groupStart = prevGroup.next
            nextGroup = groupEnd.next
            
            # 翻轉當前組
            newGroupHead, newGroupTail = reverseSegment(groupStart, groupEnd)
            
            # 連接前後
            prevGroup.next = newGroupHead
            newGroupTail.next = nextGroup
            
            # 移動到下一組
            prevGroup = newGroupTail


# 方法三：簡潔的遞迴版本
class Solution:
    def reverseKGroup(self, head: Optional[ListNode], k: int) -> Optional[ListNode]:
        # 檢查長度
        node = head
        for i in range(k):
            if not node:
                return head
            node = node.next
        
        # 翻轉 k 個節點
        prev, curr = None, head
        for i in range(k):
            curr.next, prev, curr = prev, curr, curr.next
        
        # 遞迴處理下一組
        head.next = self.reverseKGroup(curr, k)
        
        return prev
